ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white central region spanning both lobes. Low-intensity black contiguous border along the trailing edge, increasing in thickness toward the tips. Several discrete low-intensity circular clusters are distributed across the mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. A high-amplitude, irregular jagged topography is concentrated at the far left tip (terminal edge).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a slightly concave curve from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three unaligned, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, approximately 5-10 pixels in length at current resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular dark pigmentation and topographic deformation at the left lobe tip; dark 'island' mark on the left peduncle-to-fluke transition zone.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical band extending from the peduncle into the lower central fluke region.
